verses.pali: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato āvāsiko bhikkhu abhāvanīyo hoti.
verses.english: “Mendicants, a resident mendicant with five qualities is not admirable.
They’re not accomplished in being well-presented and doing their duties.
They’re not very learned and don’t remember what they’ve learned.
They’re not self-effacing and don’t enjoy self-effacement.
They’re not a good speaker and do not enunciate well.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato āvāsiko bhikkhu abhāvanīyo hoti.
verses.english: A resident mendicant with these five qualities is not admirable.

verses.pali: Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato āvāsiko bhikkhu bhāvanīyo hoti.
verses.english: A resident mendicant with these five qualities is admirable.
They’re accomplished in being well-presented and doing their duties.
They’re very learned and remember what they’ve learned.
They’re a good speaker who enunciates well.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato āvāsiko bhikkhu bhāvanīyo hotī”ti.
verses.english: A resident mendicant with these five qualities is admirable.”
